ledger.notice: No owners, C1-C4 verdicts, severity/disposition or independent reviews assigned. Stored authority hashes are references, not newly recomputed acceptance proof.

rows.title: Bounded retry/backoff
rows.canonicalRequirement: Repair loops use bounded retries and exponential backoff; crash loops are detected and do not endlessly restart/burn battery.
rows.authority: SRC-002 / Brick V1 Final Product AI Acceptance Checklist PDF / SHA256 863218723ba49c93a72d4e5e59854425ac1bf32dbebeeae15bca08db96ea6f5e
rows.evidence: Bounded computation,4/8/12-second admission waits,60-second failed/in-flight watchdog receipts; other repair-task exponential backoff remains covered by inherited tests.
rows.gap: The canonical text explicitly requires exponential backoff for repair loops. Watchdog uses fixed60-second safety-observation retry; no exception or full REL-007 acceptance is inferred. Phone crash-loop/battery qualification is outside this source batch.

rows.title: Cloud watchdog
rows.canonicalRequirement: Backend independently monitors heartbeats and transitions device health from healthy to degraded/offline based on sensible hysteresis.
rows.authority: SRC-002 / Brick V1 Final Product AI Acceptance Checklist PDF / SHA256 863218723ba49c93a72d4e5e59854425ac1bf32dbebeeae15bca08db96ea6f5e
rows.evidence: Independent root-owned active-device scan;8-device frozen-watermark pages; preserved90-second offline trigger and75-second incident start offset;60-second incident-age threshold; real Miniflare alarm continuation and failed-peer isolation.
rows.gap: Live fleet/CPU/day/latency and end-to-end healthy/degraded/offline behavior, including the existing parent-truth layer and phone recovery, still require appropriate qualification.

rows.title: Idempotent duplicate handling
rows.canonicalRequirement: Repeated delivery of the same event is logically stored/processed once and duplicates are harmless.
rows.authority: SRC-002 / Brick V1 Final Product AI Acceptance Checklist PDF / SHA256 863218723ba49c93a72d4e5e59854425ac1bf32dbebeeae15bca08db96ea6f5e
rows.evidence: Stable inc_<incident> event identity, unique D1 row, canonical payload checks, retry after delivery or acknowledgement-write failure without another D1 row.
rows.gap: Device-DO acceptance/live relay is at least once. A late remote effect or lost acknowledgement can resend the same stable ID; actual parent duplicate handling/harmlessness and the full event protocol remain unqualified.

rows.title: Alert usefulness
rows.canonicalRequirement: Parent alerts cover SOS, persistent location unavailable, persistent offline, critical battery, unhealthy service, enabled place/trip events; transient tiny delays do not alert.
rows.authority: SRC-002 / Brick V1 Final Product AI Acceptance Checklist PDF / SHA256 863218723ba49c93a72d4e5e59854425ac1bf32dbebeeae15bca08db96ea6f5e
rows.evidence: Persistent offline/service incident relay remains pending on failed acceptance; false/malformed/colliding events cannot be accepted as completed delivery; healthy peers continue.
rows.gap: SOS, battery, place/trip event usefulness, browser receipt, notification usefulness and all parent surfaces are not newly qualified by watchdog tests.

rows.title: Alert hysteresis
rows.canonicalRequirement: Ordinary transient misses progress through internal degraded/health-check stages before parent notification; SOS uses tighter thresholds.
rows.authority: SRC-002 / Brick V1 Final Product AI Acceptance Checklist PDF / SHA256 863218723ba49c93a72d4e5e59854425ac1bf32dbebeeae15bca08db96ea6f5e
rows.evidence: No change to original offline/incident-age thresholds; transient/young incidents do not relay; fresh heartbeat races cannot insert a stale offline incident.
rows.gap: Full internal degraded/health-check escalation stages, transient-noise behavior on real networks and tighter SOS timing are not established here.

rows.title: Queue-based history processing
rows.canonicalRequirement: Current live state follows a dedicated fast path and updates immediately, while history/evidence/Atlas/background processing batches asynchronously and may not head-of-line block current live position delivery.
rows.evidence: Dedicated watchdog/per-device jobs and bounded waits; independent minute/daily work starts concurrently; current request path continues to schedule root work through waitUntil; source tests cover failure isolation.
rows.gap: Uses the approved8A amended fast-live/asynchronous-background contract, not the historical queue-only title. Does not qualify every history/evidence/Atlas path, device-actor contention, real latency, or real Cloudflare Queue/DLQ operation.

rows.title: D1 PITR/logical backup
rows.canonicalRequirement: Critical structured data uses point-in-time recovery plus scheduled logical export/snapshot protection.
rows.authority: SRC-002 / Brick V1 Final Product AI Acceptance Checklist PDF / SHA256 863218723ba49c93a72d4e5e59854425ac1bf32dbebeeae15bca08db96ea6f5e
rows.evidence: Controlled slow receiver cannot prevent the existing daily backup task from completing; earlier protected recovery suites are rerun at the final executable.
rows.gap: No live PITR metadata, independent41+4 operational capture/quiescence, private destination/key custody, production backup scheduling, RTO/RPO/cloud recovery acceptance or waiver of P8D-002.
